---
title: "Variables"
subtitle: "Every column in the clean files, with the question and answer text behind it"
---




The clean survey and canvassing files have one row per respondent. Most
columns are TRUE/FALSE answer columns from choose-all-that-apply questions
(`TRUE` chosen, `FALSE` seen but not chosen, `NA` not shown or skipped);
single-answer questions are ordered categories. This page is generated from
`data/processed/data-dictionary.csv`, which the cleaning program writes.






## q1 — Connection to care

**Question:** We would like to know more about your connection to care, if any. Choose all that apply to you.

|Column            |Answer text                                                                                                     |
|:-----------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|q1_child_now      |I care for a child or children now                                                                              |
|q1_aging_now      |I care for an aging person now                                                                                  |
|q1_disability_now |I care for someone with a disability or chronic health condition now                                            |
|q1_paid_provider  |I am a paid care provider. I offer support and services for kids, aging adults, and/or people with disabilities |
|q1_need_care_now  |I need care but am not receiving it                                                                             |
|q1_receives_care  |I receive or have received care for a disability or chronic condition                                           |
|q1_cared_past     |I have cared for an aging adult, child, or someone with a disability or chronic health condition in the past    |
|q1_expect_future  |I am not providing or receiving care right now, but I expect to in the next 5 years                             |
|q1_observer       |None of these apply to me right now, but I know someone who receives or needs care                              |
|q1_none           |None of these apply to me                                                                                       |
|q1_other          |Other (any response not in the structured options)                                                              |
|q1_other_text     |Free text captured from other responses                                                                         |
